01 THE PROBLEM

Your drive remembers
every build.

A preview run here. A failed Docker build there. A simulator you forgot three releases ago. The work moves on; the artifacts stay.

The answer isn't a bigger “Clean” button. It's a better map.

03 THE DIFFERENCE

Clean with
context.

No mystery meat. No blind wipe. Just a clear path from “what is that?” to “I’m good without it.”

01

Scan the known zones

Default locations, custom project roots, and tool-specific environments — not your whole disk.

02

Review the evidence

See category, size, path, risk, and the reason an item can be reclaimed.

03

Reclaim on your terms

Selections persist. Whitelists stay local. Normal folders can go to Trash for recovery.
